text:
alex: Heads up — surge of TLS handshake failures at eu-west ingress around 09:12 UTC. Correlates with RBAC tighten that landed at 08:50. KMS unwraps are denied for some cert requests.

marta: Can you paste the log lines and any KMS audit IDs?

alex: edge-proxy excerpt:
2026-03-23T09:12:05Z edge-proxy[ingress-eu-west] WARN tls: handshake failed id=8f7a3a reason=client_hello_no_sni
2026-03-23T09:12:06Z edge-proxy[ingress-eu-west] ERROR cert-manager: request failed id=8f7a3a apiserver_err=403 secret=missing
2026-03-23T09:12:07Z kms-client[eu-west] ERROR unwrap: AccessDenied trace_id=trx-20260323-091207

leo: Audit shows infra-bot changed the role binding: audit:change=role-modify actor=infra-bot target=role/cert-provisioner-eu-west time=2026-03-23T08:49:32Z — decrypt permission removed.

jamie: That explains it. The RBAC capture accidentally stripped kms:Decrypt from the regional role.

marta: Is impact regional only?

alex: Only eu-west showing failures. Other regions' roles still have decrypt. Our cert-provisioner in eu-west uses a region-scoped role.

leo: Mitigation plan: re-add kms:Decrypt to role/cert-provisioner-eu-west with a restrictive condition (tag region:eu-west + source IP condition) and redeploy one replica as a canary. Need sec approval to change infra-bot patch.

jamie: Approve quick patch to restore decrypt for that role only. Document the change in audit and add condition.

alex: Short-term proxy fallback: enable cached cert serving for 10m and allow stale on KMS fail to reduce 503s. Config snippet: `tls_cache_ttl=10m allow_stale_on_kms_fail=true`

leo: I'll apply the IAM patch and restart a single cert-provisioner pod. Planned commands: `gcloud iam roles update role/cert-provisioner-eu-west --add-permissions=kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` and `kubectl rollout restart deployment/cert-provisioner -n platform -l region=eu-west`

marta: Capture kube events and the KMS audit trace IDs for both deny and later success. Add an incident ticket.

oncall-bot: incident created: incident/2026-03-23-eu-west-cert-unwrap (severity:medium) — runbook=cert-unwrap-degrad

leo: Patch applied and single pod redeployed at 09:28 UTC. Monitoring now.

alex: Canary pod shows handshake error rate falling. KMS trace shows success trx-20260323-092843.

marta: Proceed to roll remaining replicas, add infra PR referencing the incident and exact commands.

jamie: Long-term actions: 1) add RBAC CI test to simulate cert request flows per region, 2) IaC guard to prevent removal of kms:Decrypt from cert roles, 3) alert that correlates KMS unwrap denies with ingress TLS error rate. Assign INFRA-4123 to leo to track.

leo: Opening INFRA-4123 with remediation steps and required policy condition.

alex: We'll monitor for 2 hours then resolve. Thanks. :thumbsup:
